title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion
problem: Service unable to acquire database connections, connection pool at 100% capacity
solution:
1. Check current connection count: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity
2. Identify long-running queries: SELECT pid, now() - pg_stat_activity.query_start AS duration, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active' ORDER BY duration DESC
3. Kill blocking queries if necessary: SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid)
4. Restart application to clear connection pool
5. Increase max_connections in postgresql.conf
6. Review application connection pooling configuration

title: High Memory Usage / OOM
problem: Application memory usage continuously growing, approaching OOM
solution:
1. Check current memory usage: docker stats or kubectl top pods
2. Generate heap dump: jmap -dump:live,format=b,file=heap.bin <pid>
3. Analyze heap dump for memory leaks
4. Check for unbounded caches or collections
5. Restart service to free memory
6. Implement memory limits and monitoring
7. Add periodic garbage collection if needed

title: API Latency Spike
problem: API response times significantly higher than baseline
solution:
1. Check database query performance: pg_stat_statements
2. Identify slow queries and missing indexes
3. Check external API dependencies latency
4. Review recent deployments for code changes
5. Check resource utilization (CPU, memory, disk I/O)
6. Enable query logging for detailed analysis
7. Add database indexes if needed
8. Implement caching for frequently accessed data
